facts.fact: StackAdapt's article states that most pre-roll video inventory supports video up to 30 seconds, which it cites as a barrier for long-form marketers.
facts.quote: The barrier that many marketers are running into is that most pre-roll inventory supports video up to 30 seconds.

facts.fact: According to StackAdapt, native outstream video gives advertisers access to hundreds of tier 1 publishers, which it says is additional scale for programmatic campaigns.
facts.quote: This additional scale gives advertisers access to hundreds of tier 1 publishers, and most notably, scale programmatically run campaigns.

facts.fact: StackAdapt states that instream ads play for several seconds before a user is able to skip them.
facts.quote: instream ads start playing during a video, and play for several seconds before the user is able to skip them.

facts.fact: StackAdapt states that native outstream video auto-plays only when in view and pauses if the viewer scrolls past.
facts.quote: Native outstream video auto-plays only when in view and pauses if the viewer scrolls past.

facts.fact: StackAdapt says marketers measure native outstream performance using cost per completed view (CPCV) as a programmatic KPI.
facts.quote: marketers find native outstream very effective for achieving their programmatic KPI goals when measuring cost per completed view (CPCV).
